sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Land Laws Second Amendment Ordinance 2008
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XX OF 2008
ORDINANCE XX OF 2008
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LAND
LAWS (SECOND
AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2008
An Ordinance to repeal
the North-West Frontier
Province Land Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008 and
further to amend certain land laws
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary,
15th November, 2008]
No. Legis:1/DE/BOR/22/2001/10907,
dated 15-11-2008.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province, is hereby published for
general information:--
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient to repeal
the North-West Frontier province
Land Laws (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2008 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No.XV
of 2008), and further to amend certain land laws;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is satisfied
that circumstances exist which
render it necessary
to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier Province Land Laws (Second
Amendment) Ordinance, 2008.
(2) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 7th October, 2008..
